title: Whose Story Gets Told? Positionality and Bias in LLM Summaries of Life Narratives
reasoning: The paper benchmarks LLMs on their ability to identify and represent core themes in life narratives, specifically measuring thematic representation of 'Faith', 'Honesty', 'Integrity', 'Compassion', and 'Empathy'. It also explicitly analyzes how models handle the religious and spiritual identities of participants, as noted in the results section and related footnotes regarding religious demographics.
